errors.evidence: The description of the vertical axis omits the tick interval, which is every 20 units. The prompt explicitly requests the 'Tick-Beschriftungsintervall, wenn numerisch und regelmäßig verteilt' (tick label interval, if numerical and regularly distributed).
The phrasing 'horizontalen Achsenkategorien' (horizontal axis categories) is awkward. A clearer phrasing would be that the horizontal axis represents these categories.
